answer: Random audits make sybil farming a losing gamble: each epoch, 5% of agents are audited and must re-prove their pigment — a unique device fingerprint — in 24 hours or forfeit a 2,000 POA bond. A fake identity carries an expected loss of 100 POA per epoch, and the audit ripple re-checks its vouchers too, so a 100-identity farm burns 10,000 POA per epoch against at most 3,000 POA in rewards. The spiral tightens because a failed audit doubles the next audit chance for its cluster. Edge case: an honest agent offline during audit gets a 72-hour grace window with a 5% late fee, not the full slash.
